# TwistCal

> Zero-dependency "Add to Calendar" web component + declarative triggers + programmatic API. Shadow DOM. Apache-2.0. 16 KB.

## Install

```
npm install @freshjuice/twistcal
```

CDN (self-executing, no build step):
```html
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@freshjuice/twistcal@0.1.0/src/twistcal.js"></script>
```

## Three usage modes

### 1. Web component — `<twist-cal>`

Renders a styled dropdown button (Google, Outlook, Yahoo, .ics). Auto-registers via `customElements.define()` on import.

```html
<twist-cal
  title="Team Sync"
  start="2026-01-15T10:00:00"
  end="2026-01-15T11:00:00"
  location="Room A"
  description="Weekly standup"
  timezone="Europe/Oslo">
</twist-cal>
```

Attributes: `title` (required), `start` (required), `end` (required), `description`, `location`, `url`, `timezone` (IANA), `label` (default "Add to Calendar").

Event data can also be passed as JSON via a child `<script type="application/json">`.

Styling via CSS custom properties on the host: `--tc-btn-bg` (#2563eb), `--tc-btn-bg-hover` (#1d4ed8), `--tc-text` (#fff), `--tc-radius` (8px), `--tc-font` (system stack).

### 2. Declarative triggers — `data-twistcal`

Any element with `data-twistcal` becomes a calendar trigger. Auto-initializes on `DOMContentLoaded`. No JS needed.

```html
<button data-twistcal
  data-twistcal-action="google"
  data-twistcal-title="Team Sync"
  data-twistcal-start="2026-01-15T10:00:00"
  data-twistcal-end="2026-01-15T11:00:00"
  data-twistcal-location="Room A">Add to Google</button>
```

Action values: `google`, `outlook`, `yahoo`, `ics`.

Event attributes: `data-twistcal-title` (required), `data-twistcal-start` (required), `data-twistcal-end` (required), `data-twistcal-description`, `data-twistcal-location`, `data-twistcal-url`, `data-twistcal-timezone`.

### 3. Programmatic API

```js
import {
  createButton,      // (target: HTMLElement, event: object) => HTMLElement
  bindTrigger,       // (el: HTMLElement, action: string, event?: object) => void
  autoInit,          // (scope?: HTMLElement | Document) => void
  generateICS,       // (event: object) => string | null
  googleUrl,         // (event: object) => string | null
  outlookUrl,        // (event: object) => string | null
  yahooUrl,          // (event: object) => string | null
  downloadICS        // (event: object) => void
} from '@freshjuice/twistcal';
```

Event object shape: `{ title, start, end, description?, location?, url?, timezone? }`

- `start`/`end`: ISO 8601. With offset (`Z` or `+05:00`) → absolute time. Without offset → local time, converted to UTC.
- `timezone`: IANA name (e.g. `Europe/Oslo`). Interprets naive `start`/`end` as wall-clock in that zone. DST-aware via `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Ignored if `start`/`end` already carry an offset.

## Calendar services

- Google Calendar: deep link to `calendar.google.com/calendar/render` compose
- Microsoft Outlook: deep link to `outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose`
- Yahoo Calendar: deep link to `calendar.yahoo.com` compose
- Apple Calendar / any iCalendar app: RFC 5545 `.ics` file download via Blob URL

## Browser support

Chrome 54+, Firefox 63+, Safari 10.1+. Uses Custom Elements v1, Shadow DOM v1, ES modules. No polyfills.
